about: Commonplace exam phrasing that G7 (scripts/clean/gates.py) does not count as copying. Our own list (2026-09-29 draft): stock rubric and set-up phrases used across all boards and textbooks. The user reviews and extends it; keep each entry generic (no scenario words). An 8-word run is exempt when at least 6 of its words are maths tokens or lie inside one of these phrases.
phrases: the function f is defined by
find the coordinates of the stationary points
give your answer in the form
give your answer to 3 significant figures
give your answer to 2 decimal places
where a and b are constants
where a b and c are constants
